title: MCP entry
observations: The official MCP server works over stdio with newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0; initialize returned protocolVersion 2025-06-18, serverInfo JLCEDA Pro 4.1.78.34f5b8d9, capabilities {tools:{}}.
tools/list exposes exactly 3 meta-tools: lceda-pro.help, lceda-pro.discover, lceda-pro.call (a proxy over the CLI command surface).
tools/call lceda-pro.help returned the same command tree as the CLI; no parameterless read tool exists other than help, so a real read call needs discover -> call with arguments.
HTTP transport (--mcp http --port 3030 --token ...) was not exercised in this run.
risks: 3 generic meta-tools mean the model must discover command paths itself
no typed MCP tools per action, no schemas per EDA operation
MCP calls still need a session/project context; concurrency/auth for HTTP mode is untested here
